intro: This fictional teaching game demonstrates the skill's board, commentary, and move practice.
overview: White's queen captures the f7-pawn with check, protected by the bishop on c4. Black's king cannot capture the queen, and Black has no other way to escape check.
strengths: The final move delivers a verified mate in one.

training.title: Check every way to escape check
training.text: Determine whether the opponent can capture the attacker, block the check, or move the king.

notes_prompt: Why did I conclude that this move was checkmate?
review_guide: Select “Try a move” to find the final move, then use “Full replay” to check the complete game.
ending: White wins by checkmate. This is a fictional teaching example.
provenance: This example uses manually written commentary. The demonstration line and checkmate are validated by python-chess. Stockfish was not run to build this demonstration.
date_note: The date and player names are for teaching purposes only and do not come from a personal game.
